lines.content: - [ ] Each touched independent repository has a scoped commit, pushed branch, ready-for-review PR, and requested automerge enabled; unrelated dirty work remains untouched.
- [ ] The obsolete source-path worktree and duplicate artifacts are retired only after their changes are accounted for and recovery is documented.
- Prep done in the yazelix worktree (`nix/gha-runner`): the hermetic nix runner is now
**systemd-scrubbed** and ready to consolidate — removed `scripts/gha-runner.service`; dropped the
`writeTextDir lib/systemd/user/…` packaging from `flake.nix` (closure ships only the nix-store
`flexnetos-runner-boot` binary, invoked `nix run .#service`); rewrote `verify.mjs` to **assert the
unit is ABSENT** and to forbid `systemd|systemctl|enable-linger|loginctl`; scrubbed README/RUNBOOK.
`bun run verify.mjs` → **33/33 gates, exit 0**. This scrubbed tree is the source to copy into
- Verified low-risk for the meta-root move: no references to `src/flexnetos_runner` in root
87–89 with `path: src/flexnetos_runner` (drop `path:` to default to meta root).
- Live-run baseline preserved: the runner already ran green on `[self-hosted,flexnetos,nix]`
(run 30014284241 attempt 2 success) — the consolidation must not regress this (AC5-equivalent).
- [[tasks/gha-runner-nix-native-persistence]] — hard persistence constraint and proof requirements.

commit.message:
gha-runner: systemd scrubbed (verify 33/33), progress on canonical promotion

(nix run .#service boot closure only). Progress logged on canonical promotion task;
duplicate consolidate-task discarded (flexnetos-runner-canonical-promotion is canonical).
